text:
```yaml
name: Stale Pull Requests

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          # Only handle pull requests
          days-before-pr-stale: 15
          days-before-pr-close: 7
          
          # Disable issue handling
          days-before-issue-stale: -1
          days-before-issue-close: -1
          
          # Labels
          stale-pr-label: "stale"
          
          # Messages
          stale-pr-message: >
            This pull request has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had
            recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs in the next 7 days.
            Thank you for your contributions.
          close-pr-message: >
            This pull request has been automatically closed due to inactivity.
            Please feel free to reopen it if you wish to continue working on it.
          
          # Exempt labels
          exempt-pr-labels: "pinned,work-in-progress,on-hold"
          
          # Operations
          operations-per-run: 100
          remove-stale-when-updated: true
```
